name: Pick-and-Pay Garden
whyItWorks: Connects guests to the land, and kids love harvesting their own vegetables and fruit.
description: Wander through our working garden and hand-pick fresh vegetables and fruit, paid by weight, to take home or have cooked for you.

name: Sugarcane Maze
whyItWorks: Unique to Negros' sugarcane heritage, with strong potential to go viral on social media.
description: Get lost (on purpose) in a living maze grown from Negros' signature crop - a fun, only-here photo opportunity.

name: Inasal Masterclass
whyItWorks: A cultural immersion activity that builds top-of-mind status for the resort's food identity.
description: Learn to marinate and grill chicken inasal the Bacolod way, guided by our in-house cooks.

name: Kawa Hot Baths
whyItWorks: A high-end relaxation experience that is very popular on TikTok and Reels.
description: Soak in a traditional kawa (giant cauldron) filled with warm herbal water for a relaxing spa-like experience.

name: Carabao Cart Ride
whyItWorks: A nostalgic, easy-to-run activity that highlights Negros' farming heritage for both kids and balikbayan guests.
description: A slow, scenic ride around the grounds aboard a cart pulled by a carabao, our national farm animal.

name: Native Games Afternoon
whyItWorks: Low-cost, high-fun group activity (palo sebo, tumbang preso, piko) that's great for family reunions and team-building groups.
description: A guided session of classic Filipino outdoor games, perfect for big groups and multi-generational visits.

name: Bonfire & Acoustic Nights
whyItWorks: Turns an overnight stay into a shareable evening experience, extending guests' time (and spend) on-site.
description: Gather around a bonfire in the evening with live acoustic music, perfect for overnight villa guests.

name: Farm-to-Table Cooking Class
whyItWorks: Pairs naturally with the Pick-and-Pay Garden and appeals to the growing wellness/organic-travel audience.
description: Harvest ingredients from our garden, then cook a Negrense dish from scratch with guidance from our kitchen team.
